reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The measured 132.136019 m² remainder (0.2414%) was inspected in an EPSG:2154 overlay of the pinned INAO boundary and original commune parcels, with close views of its largest components. All five components touch the INAO boundary: 110.625903 m² follows the western boundary, with 14.241392, 3.844131, 2.950959 and 0.473634 m² on the eastern boundary. These are narrow cadastral/INAO boundary mismatches, not a missing commune. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered or filled. The absolute cap allows less than 0.1 m² above the reviewed measurement; changed source hashes require another review.
